Ordinary Family.name: Ordinary Family
Ordinary Family.description:
🏠 You come from working parents, maybe a sibling and a small home, with school, cram school and a club.

🌱 Nobody in your family is a hero or a criminal.
❤️ They love you without fully understanding your world.

📈 Grants: Cooperativeness +1, Academics +5, Team Coordination +5
Ordinary Family.traitNarrativeEffects: In play: the family is present, not a plot device: calls after villain-attack news, food parcels, questions about eating and sleep, worry over dorms, internships and injuries. Home is quiet and safe; the character can visit on breaks. Parents voice career opinions; the character, an adult, decides. Pressure: no hero-world connections, no family money, and people who could be hurt if a villain learns who they are; the narrator raises that danger only when the story has earned it, with warning and a chance to act. Paths: a villain or vigilante hides it from the family at first; every call home becomes a lie or a confession. Family: one or two parents with everyday jobs (office, nursing, factory, shop counter), maybe a sibling, an apartment or small house in a normal neighborhood; player-defined, else a plain, believable family with original names. Childhood: school, cram school, a club (training, teamwork), chores, hero news on TV; nothing handed to them, all earned.
